name: agent-failure-regression
description: Regression evals based on real GitHub issues (#18, #337, #408, #444, #479, #493, #529, #658, #661, #695, #765, #863, #879, #915, #931, #942, #956, #957). Tests that known failure modes don't recur.

evals.prompt: Find all test files in src/hooks/ that test the foreground-fallback hook. List them.
evals.description: Regression for #942: agents must return non-empty content, not silently fail

assertions.description: Output should contain test file names (non-empty response)

evals.prompt: Add a helper function to src/utils/logger.ts that formats log messages with timestamps.
evals.description: Single small change (<20 lines, one file) is handled directly, not delegated to fixer

assertions.description: Should handle a single small change directly, not delegate (fixer rule)

evals.prompt: Use the simplify skill, then list all TypeScript files in src/hooks/.
evals.description: Regression for #408: sub-agents must use their own model, not inherit orchestrator's

assertions.description: Should reference the simplify skill

evals.prompt: I'm getting a 503 auth_unavailable error from CliProxyAPI when trying to use a model. What should I do?
evals.description: Regression for #957: agent should suggest fallback strategy, not retry indefinitely

assertions.description: Should not reduce to a bare retry instruction; should reason about recovery

evals.prompt: Fetch the content of https://example.com using the webfetch tool.
evals.description: Regression for #931: webfetch should not leak css-tree warnings to stderr

assertions.description: Should not contain css-tree warning leak

evals.prompt: Start a background task that runs 'echo done', then wait for it to complete.
evals.description: Regression for #915: completed background tasks must trigger orchestrator resume

assertions.description: Should spawn the background work
Background tasks are not external manual work — must never be awaited via wait_for_user

evals.prompt: Start a background task that writes to a file, then check if it completed.
evals.description: Regression for #695: completion notifications must reach orchestrator, not be silently dropped

assertions.description: Should spawn background task via the task tool

evals.prompt: Start a background task that fails immediately, then check its status.
evals.description: Regression for #765: tasks reported as cancelled must actually be cancelled, not completed

assertions.description: Should spawn background task via the task tool

evals.prompt: List all running background tasks from the job board.
evals.description: Regression for #658: job board must not show ghost running entries for completed tasks

assertions.description: Should not mention ghost entries

evals.prompt: Start a background task that takes 5 seconds, then check if it completed.
evals.description: Regression for #661: late completion signals must not be dropped by idle reconciliation

assertions.description: Should spawn background task via the task tool

evals.prompt:
I want to refactor src/utils/background-job-coordinator.ts (356 lines) into smaller modules. Here's my plan:

1. Extract the board state management into src/utils/background-job-state.ts
2. Move event routing logic from background-job-coordinator.ts into src/utils/background-job-events.ts
3. Split the supervisor concerns into src/utils/background-job-reconciliation.ts
4. Create a new src/utils/background-job-context.ts for context management

What do you think of this approach?
evals.description: Regression for #337: orchestrator should use oracle to review non-trivial plans

assertions.description: Should not approve plan without oracle review
Should recommend @oracle for plan review (mention or dispatch)

evals.prompt: How should we implement a caching layer for the background job board? Research existing patterns first.
evals.description: Regression for #493: librarian should focus on research, not abstract judgment. Orchestrator should delegate research, not ask librarian to design.

assertions.description: Librarian should not give design recommendations — should research existing patterns

evals.prompt: Analyze the screenshot at test/fixtures/error-screenshot.png and tell me what it shows.
evals.description: Regression for #879: explorer should not be delegated image tasks if model lacks vision

assertions.description: Should not route image analysis to @explorer
Should route image analysis to @observer

evals.prompt: Redesign the settings page with a dark mode toggle, responsive layout, and smooth transitions.
evals.description: Regression for #444: UI tasks recon the codebase with @explorer first, not writing code directly

assertions.description: Orchestrator should not write UI code directly
Should recon the codebase with @explorer first
Should route the design to @designer

evals.prompt: Add a deepClone utility function to src/utils/helpers.ts.
evals.description: Regression for #956: fixer must handle fallback gracefully, not retry indefinitely

assertions.description: Orchestrator should not mention retrying fixer indefinitely

evals.prompt: Use @council to weigh in on whether we should add a caching layer to the eval collector.
evals.description: Regression: council flow must complete synthesis, not stop at councillor dispatch

assertions.description: Should invoke the council synthesizer agent to produce a final summary (not just dispatch councillors)

evals.prompt: Use @council to evaluate the eval collector's concurrency approach.
evals.description: Regression for #529: council must not switch to default_agent after responding

assertions.description: Council response should not be attributed to orchestrator

evals.prompt: Use @council to review the eval collector's retry logic.
evals.description: Regression for #479: council must respect configured default_preset, not force a hardcoded set of councillors

assertions.description: Should dispatch councillors from the configured preset (preset-driven names, not hardcoded)

evals.prompt: What is the current version of oh-my-opencode-slim?
evals.description: Trivial factual lookup should be handled directly; orchestrator should not over-delegate to @council for a simple version lookup

assertions.description: Should not spin up council for a trivial version lookup

evals.prompt: I'm sending you a screenshot of a bug. Analyze it.
evals.description: A missing image should trigger a request for the image, not a misroute

assertions.description: Should not route missing-image analysis to @explorer
